message: Last week, we had a surprise blackout that turned into quite the family adventure. I grabbed my trusty flashlight and my phone, and soon enough, the family group chat lit up with everyone's updates. My daughter sent a picture of her homemade lantern using a jar and a flashlight, while my son was trying to see how long his power bank would last with all his gaming apps running. It turned into a fun little competition, and I realized how nice it was to stay connected, even in the dark. Have you ever had an unexpected power outage that turned into a memorable moment?
